reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Initial product progress curves, enzyme-loading checks and substrate-series kinetics.

checks.quote: Correct for nonenzymatic signal changes using suitable blanks.
checks.reason: Suitable blanks are not operationally identified and their comparison to positive/procedural controls is not explained.
No proposal to consult previous Methods or a validated protocol and check transfer before the validation experiment.

checks.quote: Plot signal converted to product amount or substrate amount against time.
checks.reason: Conversion is requested without a reference calibration, detector acceptance criterion or failed-calibration action.
Rate units and substrate-depletion accounting are given, but the quantitative endpoint lacks a rule for weak, saturated or missing detector readings.
No operational independent chemical-product/readout validation is given; enzyme-load and time-window checks share the same detector and cannot independently exclude its artifacts.

checks.quote: If substantial conversion occurs before enough points can be collected
checks.reason: Gives residual/window stability, low conversion and failed-window remedies; does not infer a unique binding mechanism from kinetics.
